business_summary: Konoike Transport Co.,Ltd. engages in logistics business in Japan and internationally. The company also provides value-added services in the steel industry; repair and maintenance services of manufacturing facilities; design, creation, and processing of plant equipment, as well as installation and maintenance work; receiving and preparing raw materials, packaging, and conducting equipment inspection; temperature-controlled logistics services; and support services at airports. In addition, it is involved in contract operations of maintenance, construction, and manufacture of chemicals, gases, and housing facilities; storage and distribution of various materials, general apparel merchandise, and daily necessities; refurbishment and coating of industrial air conditioners; provision of renewable energy services; solar power generation and other PPA projects; transportation of industrial gas tank trucks and machine tools; inspection, maintenance, and mechanic support for imported automobiles; manufacture and sale of frozen fishery processed foodstuff. Further, the company engages in the import/export cargo warehousing and transportation of cargo; railway transportation of containers and automobiles; cleaning and sterilization outsourcing of medical devices; contracting operations of in-hospital logistics; operating room assistance; sales of various systems; and provision of management support and other services. Konoike Transport Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1880 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
